one_liner: Machine Gun v8: a networked, overheat‑aware weapon with pickup action, UI bar, and rich emote animations.
primary_use_case: Provide players with a responsive firearm that tracks overheating, supports reload, and offers visual UI feedback during combat.
preview_recommendation: Use the arena test video (p1_arena_test.mp4) to showcase the overheat bar, shooting mechanics, and animation transitions when the gun is picked up.
